description: This Java source file defines a class 'ConceptValidatorChangeSet' that implements a Liquibase custom task to validate and update concept names in the OpenMRS database, particularly after converting core concept name tags to concept name types. It performs validation of concept names by locale, ensures uniqueness, sets default names, and handles data integrity issues within the concept table.
